formative_worksheets.title: The Tally and Pictograph Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (10 minutes) to confirm D1.2 (tally) and D1.3 (pictograph) before extending into ordering.
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check that probes whether the child can read tallies AND build a pictograph with one-to-one. Catches children who succeed at tallying but fail at one-to-one pictograph construction before they hit the capstone.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can read tallies and build a pictograph.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can read tallies and build a pictograph.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dot in the top-right corner with a clipboard. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: Read the tallies. Write the totals.
prompts.visual_layout: A 3-row mini tally chart: Apples ||||CROSS || (7), Bananas |||| (4), Grapes ||||CROSS (5). Each row has an empty total box.

image_placeholders.description: A 3-row tally chart for a Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. Row 1: 'Apples' label + ||||CROSS || tally + empty total box. Row 2: 'Bananas' label + |||| tally + empty total box. Row 3: 'Grapes' label + ||||CROSS tally + empty total box. Each row ~3.5in × 0.8in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_TALLIES at Prompt 1: instructions ask the child to read tallies and write totals. Keywords name the activity (tally, totals).

prompts.prompt: Build a pictograph from the tallies above. Add title and labels.
prompts.visual_layout: A blank 3-row pictograph grid below Prompt 1. Title line at top, label boxes beside each row, ~7 grid cells per row.

image_placeholders.description: A blank 3-row pictograph grid for a Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. ~5in × 2.5in. Each row has a label box on the left, ~7 grid cells in the middle. Above the grid, an empty title line. Designed for the child to build a pictograph from the Q1 tally totals.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_GRID at Prompt 2: instructions ask the child to build a pictograph. Keywords name the format (pictograph) and required component (title).

prompts.answer_key: Pictograph with: Title (e.g., 'Favourite Fruit'), Apples row with 7 pictures, Bananas with 4, Grapes with 5. Pictures one-to-one and same size.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling about tallies and pictographs? Circle the face.
prompts.visual_layout: Three faces in a row: smile, neutral, frown. Below: 'I got it!', 'Almost!', 'Need help!'.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a horizontal row for a Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. Left: smile. Middle: neutral. Right: frown. Each ~1.5in across. Below each, label: 'I got it!', 'Almost!', 'Need help!'. Total row ~6in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: instructions ask the child to circle their feeling. Keywords name the visual (faces, feeling).

prompts.answer_key: Open. Use this self-rating alongside Prompts 1 and 2 to identify mismatches.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child. Score guide: Q1 + Q2 perfect + 'I got it' = ready for ordering. Q1 right but Q2 has size-varying pictures = re-loop on one-to-one. Q1 wrong = re-loop on tally totals.

reflection_sheet.title: My Detective's Reflection
reflection_sheet.purpose: End-of-unit metacognition. Children look back at their week as data detectives.
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dot and Tally in the top-right corner with a Junior Data Detective certificate. Small (~1.5in combined). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Data Detective? Circle one.
prompts.visual_layout: Three star-rating ovals: 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars. Below: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am a Detective!'.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals for a Grade 1 reflection sheet. Left: 1 star. Middle: 2 stars. Right: 3 stars. Each oval ~2in × 1.5in. Below each, label: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am a Detective!'. Total ~6.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS at Prompt 1: instructions ask the child to rate themselves. Keywords name the rating (stars) and role (detective).

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.
prompts.visual_layout: A four-row table. Each row: question + YES/NO bubbles.

image_placeholders.description: A 4-row YES/NO table for a Grade 1 reflection sheet. Each row ~1in tall. Left column ~4in with question. Right column ~2in with YES / NO bubbles. Total ~6in. Thin row dividers.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE at Prompt 2: instructions ask the child to circle yes or no. Keywords name the response options.

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle ~5in × 1.8in for a Grade 1 reflection sheet. Empty inside. Above: 'My favourite detective step was...'. Faint guide-lines at bottom.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX at Prompt 3: instructions ask the child for their favourite. Keywords name the prompt focus.

prompts.prompt: The trickiest part for me was...

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle ~5in × 1.8in for a Grade 1 reflection sheet. Above: 'The trickiest part for me was...'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX at Prompt 4: instructions ask what was 'trickiest'. Keyword matches the prompt.

prompts.prompt: Next time, I want to try...

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle ~5in × 1.8in for a Grade 1 reflection sheet. Above: 'Next time, I want to try...'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX at Prompt 5: instructions ask for a forward goal. Keywords name the focus.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at the end of Lesson 5, alongside the Junior Data Detective certificate. Children may need scribe support for prompts 3-5. Read responses to inform next-year unit notes.
